name: search_store_plugins
description: Check the NuCore plugin store for an existing plugin that already covers what the user described, before researching or generating a custom one. Scores every store plugin against the user's own words and returns them ranked, with recommend_and_stop set when a plausible match exists. If a viable match is found, recommend it and stop there -- only continue to search_github_plugins/search_web/generation if the user explicitly says they still want a custom plugin.

query.description: The device/service and capability the user described, in their own words (e.g. 'pool controller temperature and pump control').
